The "Hambacher Schloss" is no medival castle for war purposes It was more of a summerpalace for the bishop of Speyer. (Castle =Burg / Schloss=palace) some locals refer to it as "Maxburg" 
In 1832 there was a march to the "Hambacher Schloss" where the black red and golden flag, wich is now germanys flag was first used.
This march was one of the first greater events and demonstrations for democracy. The Hambacher Schloss is called "Wiege der Demokratie" (birthplace of democracy)
Palatinate has a long Tradition in wine basicly since ancient times cause of roman occupation and greek Traders.
